Offline runtime dependencies, pinned for FPGA Project Reader.
Unmodified distributions; wrapper, HTML UI and model adapter are separate resources.

d3 6.7.0 — https://github.com/d3/d3/tree/v6.7.0 — D3-LICENSE.txt
elkjs 0.8.2 — https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/tree/v0.8.2 — ELK-LICENSE.txt
d3-hwschematic 0.1.6 — https://github.com/Nic30/d3-hwschematic — HWSCHEMATIC-LICENSE.txt
The upstream package metadata says EPL-1.0; its included LICENSE is EPL-2.0.
The complete upstream license texts are preserved with these distributions.
No CDN, telemetry, server or dependency installation is used by the generated viewer.
